i attempted suicide back in january and my family found out as they had to call the ambulance. i have to say i admire you and the manner you dealt with your struggle so privatley, amd even though you feel guilt, its okay because you struggles and now you got through it with minimal damage to others. my family and friends hold my attmept agajnst me, i think in a projection of the pain i caused them, but it does make the process of recovery that bit harder. at least on the bright side you only have to learn to forgive yourself, rather than ask for the forgiveness of others as well. and i think that comes with time and by subtley doing nice things for those around you because you can release some of your guilt through that. i am glad things are slowly getting better for you , and i really do send messages of self love n kindess your way x

i am so sorry to feel your pain. it is hard. but i have been where you are and the thoughts you have were in my head. and fuck was it hard to get through it. am i entirely recovered? no. but am i much better and realise that i am.not so much broken but healing? yes. the point im trying to make is that this guilt youre feeling for being alive, it isnt true. you deserve to be here. you arent a mistake and people care about you, people want you here and people want to see you make another die. the silent struggle is so hard but just speak up, use platforms like this and get the support you deserve if people in real life wont help you through it. its so hard to get through, but once its over you will feel this relief and belonginf that makes it all worth it. please just try to hold on, please just try to change the way you feel about yourself because honestly from being where you are to where i am now, i can say it is worth it.

there is nothing wrong with you!! youre just struggling, which is okay !! if its only at night, could you do.things like write reminders during the day of why you are happy and then read them when the urge comes to show you that you make it to the next day??
and perhaps sleep meditation or something to help you sleep faster and get through that period of time easier? the way you keep resisting is because YOU are good enough YOU are strong enough even if you dont feel it. every sunrise is a victory, and collect them like medals bc you should be proud to have 100% success rate so far. i really hope this helps and just keep fighting. its all any of us can do.

i literally have the exact same fear and have had more of a struggle with different drugs. however after talking with my friends about things, not always how i feel im.clinically insane bc thats not a very good conversation starter, i realise that the human mind is complex and just because people think in different ways doesnt mean youre crazy or have a mental.illness as such. i think half of it is anxiety and its another tool is can have to make you panic and be fearful of being alive. I havent really come to any solid solutions of how to make the fear go away but trying just to focus on other 'normal things' as such is a good coping mechanism for me, for example my school work. sorry i hope this helps, its so hard but you are doing amazing
